name: aromir_benzene_v13
purpose: TASKS 73 (the user, 15 Nov: release v1.3 for aromir, step f): the first real certificate — `aromir spectrum c1ccccc1` on release v1.3 (chain 35's three checkpoints converted, modules/05_support_predictor/out/aromir_release_v1.3), in WSL ~/aromir_v13 (aromir 387e308f, torch 2.14.0, pyscf 2.15.0). v1.3 was trained on unrepaired Hessians, so no soft-mode repair runs. aromir prints nothing while pyscf works; probes/aromir_run_wsl.sh prints a progress line every five minutes while the process's CPU time grows.
command: env CAP_MB=4096 THREADS=8 bash ../aromir_run.sh aromir_benzene_v13_2026-11-15 spectrum c1ccccc1

estimate.basis: aromir's own benzene run in the cloud container on 4 threads: optimisation 205 s, Hessian and polar tensor 720 s (docs/HANDOFF_2026-11-15_aromir_stage1.md)

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 4096 MB (CAP_MB; pyscf max_memory 2048); benzene at B3LYP/6-31G* is 102 basis functions
